# EHS Stack

> Training for EHS managers who run HAZWOPER and hazardous waste programs: train-the-trainer, supervisor, incident command, contingency planning, RCRA generator and state-plan refresher courses.

EHS Stack (https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Train-the-Trainer, Supervisor, Incident Command, Contingency Plan or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [HAZWOPER Train-the-Trainer Certification](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification): $399.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). Become a qualified in-house HAZWOPER trainer under 1910.120(e)(5). Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification?buy=1016
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $179.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). The 8-hour HAZWOPER supervisor course under 1910.120(e)(4). Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $179.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command for HAZWOPER emergency response. Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [Hazardous Waste Contingency Plan and Emergency Coordinator Training](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR Parts 262 and 264/265. RCRA contingency plans and the emergency coordinator role. Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). RCRA generator training for EHS staff and waste handlers. Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher - State-Plan Versions Available](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-state-plan-versions-available): $84.99 per seat, 8 Hours, State-plan equivalents of federal OSHA standard (see parent course). 8-hour refresher covering federal and state-plan HAZWOPER rules. Enroll: https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-state-plan-versions-available?buy=900

## Guides

- [The HAZWOPER program checklist for EHS managers](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-program-checklist): Training is one piece. Here's every element an inspector expects a HAZWOPER program to have.
- [Tracking training renewal cycles across your workforce](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/tracking-training-renewal-cycles): Every rule has its own clock. A reference table for the cycles EHS teams track most.
- [HAZWOPER medical surveillance: who, when and what](https://ehs-managers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-medical-surveillance): Paragraph (f) is easy to overlook and expensive to get wrong. The essentials.
